newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shiseido up on purchase of Helene Curtis unit.
newsitem.headline: Shiseido up on purchase of Helene Curtis unit.

text.p: Shiseido Co Ltd shares were up on Wednesday morning on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, renewing a high for the calendar year, after Shiseido announced on Monday that it had agreed to buy one of Helene Curtis Industries Inc's Japanese units, traders said.
At 0135 GMT Shiseido shares were up 80 yen at 1,840. Turnover was 1.36 million shares.
The previous high for the calendar year was 1,760 yen marked on Monday.
"Shares are up because investors see the purchase of (the) Helene Curtis (unit) as a positive factor that will increase the company's profits," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.

Shiseido, a leading Japanese cosmetics firm, announced on Monday that it agreed with Helene Curtis parent Unilever NV to acquire 100 percent of the shares and all product and trademark rights of Helene Curtis Japan, one of Helene Curtis' two Japanese units, for an estimated 3.5 to 4.0 billion yen.
